_readme: Image and audio credits shown on /credits/. Add one object per item to 'items'. Fields: kind ('image' or 'audio'), title, creator, sourceUrl (page documenting the licence), license (e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0', 'Public domain'), licenseUrl (optional), usedOn (optional site path, e.g. '/figures/ramana-maharshi/'). Portraits set in a chapter's frontmatter 'photo' field are listed automatically and need no entry here.
